# Cursor Rules Generator (https://cursor.pacebowl.com)

> Free, production-grade, client-side modular .cursor/rules/*.mdc generator for Cursor AI, Claude Code (CLAUDE.md), and Windsurf (.windsurfrules). Prevents LLM context saturation and saves ~75% prompt tokens.

## Machine-Readable Resources
- [Agent Skills Index](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Machine-executable skill schemas and endpoints for autonomous agents.
- [Full LLM Knowledge Spec](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive rule catalog, YAML frontmatter schemas, and glob specifications.
- [Rules Open API Catalog](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/api/rules.json): Direct structured JSON catalog of production rules and raw .mdc contents.
- [Model Context Protocol Specification](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/api/mcp.json): MCP server manifest and client configuration blueprint for IDE agents.
- [Canonical Sitemap](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap index for search crawlers and generative agents.

## Core Tool Capabilities & Direct Landing Pages
- [Cursor Rules Generator Hub](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/): Main interactive builder with live glob simulation and 1-click terminal injection.
- [Next.js 15 Rules (.mdc)](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/rules/nextjs-15.html): App Router, Server Actions, and React Server Components boundaries.
- [Python FastAPI Rules (.mdc)](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/rules/python-fastapi.html): Pydantic v2, async endpoints, and dependency injection.
- [React 19 & Vite Rules (.mdc)](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/rules/react-vite.html): Pure functional components, clean custom hooks, and strict TypeScript.
- [Vue 3 & Nuxt Rules (.mdc)](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/rules/vue3-nuxt.html): Composition API with script setup, Pinia state actions.
- [Supabase & RLS Rules (.mdc)](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/rules/supabase.html): Row Level Security enforcement and typed client SDK.
- [Tailwind CSS v4 Rules (.mdc)](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/rules/tailwind-css.html): Atomic utility classes, cn() merging, and mobile-first styles.

- [Rules Directory Hub](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/rules/): Complete overview and search directory for production rules.

## Key Technical Specifications & Standards
- Architecture: 100% Client-Side Web Application, Zero Server Queues, $0 Cost.
- Frontmatter Standard: YAML headers with description, globs matching, and alwaysApply flags to prevent context pollution.
- Multi-Target Compilers: Supports Cursor .mdc, Claude Code CLAUDE.md, Windsurf .windsurfrules, and legacy .cursorrules.
- Live Glob Matcher: Real-time path evaluation against glob patterns with ~75% token reduction visualization.

## Engineering Guides & Tutorials
- [Cursor Rules (.mdc) vs .cursorrules Migration Guide](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/blog/cursor-rules-mdc-vs-cursorrules.html): Explains the technical rationale behind replacing monolithic .cursorrules with path-scoped .mdc files.
- [How to Write Next.js 15 Cursor Rules](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/blog/how-to-write-nextjs-15-cursor-rules.html): Production rules for App Router, React Server Components boundaries, and Server Actions.
- [The 10-Level AI Coding Maturity Ladder](https://cursor.pacebowl.com/blog/ai-coding-maturity-ladder.html): From raw chat prompter to modular .mdc, TDD feedback loops, and autonomous multi-agent CI/CD swarms.
